_comment: E2-A literature-realistic labels for the E1 settings (reports/e2_literature.md section 3). Replaces the E1 rule 'realistic = all but the most severe setting'. Severities use the E1 config's own units (degrees, multiples of L, factors, sigma, level numbers). realistic = inside the documented range of at least one real hint source named in 'source'; edge = at the limit of what a source reports; beyond = larger than every source found; unsourced = plausible but no source gives a size. Written 2026-10-29, before any E2-C/D/E/F run.

noise_rot.source: 0.5-2 deg: phone VIO orientation error < 2 deg on average (ADVIO). 5 deg: compass-derived rotations, mean deviations 5.5-6.9 deg (Tartachynska & Pylypyak 2026), beyond VIO

noise_trans.source: VIO drift 6-14.6% of distance (Feigl et al. 2020); GPS is far larger (>= 0.7 L)

outlier_rot.source: indoor magnetometer heading error 12.45 deg average (Abadi et al., IPIN 2013); isolated compass deviations 13-25 deg; >30 deg spread only in a conference abstract (Jones 2021); 90 deg unsourced

outlier_trans_small.source: VIO 'wild jumps' exist (ADVIO) but no size is given

outlier_trans_large.source: phone GPS 4.9 m open sky (GPS.gov), 7-13 m urban, max 99.7 m (Merry & Bettinger 2019); 10 L is inside for L <= 1.3 m, tails only for meadow (L = 6.76 m)

outlier_frac.source: the per-view error (15 deg + 0.25 L) is inside indoor compass error; no source gives the fraction of views affected

scale_all.source: monocular VO/SLAM: relative scale change 1:0.37 over one loop (Strasdat et al., RSS 2010); x0.8/x1.25 are at the edge for phone VIO (6-14.6%)

drift.source: heading-rate part 0.5/1/2 deg per photo = 0.8/1.6/3.2 deg per metre on the median clip, vs < 0.01 deg/m for phone VIO (ADVIO: < 2 deg over ~194 m) and ~0.12 deg/m gyro-only (Yang et al. 2020, OpenAlex abstract). The scale-growth part of levels 1-2 (5.1%/10.6% of path) is inside VIO drift (Feigl et al. 2020); level 3 (22.3%) is beyond

shared_heading_bias.source: compass bias 1-3 deg after calibration, 2-3x worse later, mean deviations up to 6.9 deg (Tartachynska & Pylypyak 2026); 12.45 deg average indoors (Abadi et al.)

anchor_error.source: level 1 = 15 deg on view 0 (indoor compass); level 2 = 0.25 L (VIO-level offset)

focal_all.source: EXIF focal 'usually good, but can occasionally be off by more than a factor of two'; SfM accepts 0.7-1.4 (Snavely et al. 2006); vendor flags > 5% (Pix4D); no error distribution found

focal_one.source: limit of the 0.7-1.4 window (Snavely et al. 2006)

principal_shift.source: default vs calibrated principal point <= 2.5% of width (TUM RGB-D); crop bugs unsourced

depth_scale.source: monocular metric-depth networks on ETH3D: AbsRel 0.34-0.55 (Metric3D v2, ZoeDepth; Metric3D v2 Table 3). Beyond active sensors (2-3.5% bias: TUM Kinect, Wasenmueller & Stricker 2016, phone LiDAR)

depth_noise.source: monocular depth AbsRel 0.05-0.07 on NYU/KITTI (Metric3D v2); depth edges (flying pixels); beyond active sensors on flat surfaces

metric_flag_off.source: categorical user error, no size to source
